items.title: 6.3.1.3 Machine Learning and AI in the Cloud (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Cloud computing machine learning models aur artificial intelligence (AI) applications banane aur chalane ke liye taqatwar tools deti hai.

Misal (Example): Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker machine learning models banane, train karne (data se sikhane) aur deploy karne ke cloud platforms dete hain. In services se data scientists aur developers apne paas bare computers rakhe baghair AI ke hal bana sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: AI model school ke computer ki bajaye cloud par train karna kyun behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: Training ke liye thore waqt ke liye bohat zyada computing taqat chahiye. Cloud mehnga hardware khareedne ki bajaye yeh taqat zaroorat ke waqt kiraye par de deti hai.

items: Cloud par ML aur AI: models banana, train aur deploy karna (Google Cloud AI, AWS SageMaker).
Bare local computers ki zaroorat nahi.
